name: @chenish/zentao-mcp-agent
stderr:
Usage: zentao [options] [command]

Zentao CLI Tool for Agent V4 Framework

Options:
  -V, --version                 output the version number
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]               Login to Zentao and save the token to local
                                config
  view <text>                   Smart resolve and fetch ZenTao entity from text
  my [options] <type>           Get my dashboard items
  projects                      Get active projects
  executions [options]          Get active executions/sprints
  execution [options] <action>
  task [options] <action>
  story [options] <action>      Update story lifecycle or assignment through
                                REST workflow nodes
  bug [options] <action>        Update bug lifecycle or assignment through REST
                                workflow nodes
  team [options] <action>       管理本地缓存的团队别名，供
                                manage/load/stagnant/morning-check 复用
  manage [options]              管理视角聚合指定成员的任务、需求、缺陷
  load [options]                查看指定成员的当前并发任务数与剩余工时（仅供派单参考，不强制阻断）
  stagnant [options]            排查指定成员名单中长期未更新（停滞）的进行中任务
  morning-check [options]       生成晨会作战沙盘：汇总已超期、今明到期、高优事项三类预警清单
  weekly-synthesis [options]    生成团队周报素材：聚合本周高优需求交付与重大缺陷修复
  help [command]                display help for command
